body:
Second half of GFD-UA-001 (first half -- sign-up button shelling to IDUNA's register form -- shipped earlier). New gfd_registration_settings/gfd_waitlist tables, PlayerEmailAuthHandler.handleRegister checks the mode, /admin/gfd-registration admin page toggles mode + approves waitlist entries into real accounts using the password hash captured at signup. 6 new tests, go test ./... clean. Commit 88802b8. Redeployed live IDUNA, migration applied, verified real 401 on both new routes.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-UA-001 complete: real waitlist toggle for GFD registration
